children: Tessera Defense & Homeland Security expanded its strategic relationship with M.E.A. Testing Systems and related parties. The company amended its share purchase agreement with Mayers Ventures to lift its initial MEA stake to 15% from 10%, paid in 195,000 Tessera shares (with 65,000 pending listing authorization), and closed the previously agreed 10% tranche with 130,000 shares issued. Tessera also put in place a $475,000 unsecured, 12% convertible loan facility to support MEA and Motomova funding needs, with an option to convert subject to a 19.999% ownership cap. Additionally, Tessera secured a perpetual, worldwide license that is exclusive for UAV testing technologies and transferable without consent.
